scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n app,api,swa -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @siro/app" "npm run dev -w @siro/api" "swa start siro"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @siro/db && npm run build -w @siro/app && npm run build -w @siro/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @siro/db && npm run typecheck -w @siro/api && npx -w @siro/app tsc -b
scripts.test: npm run test -w @siro/api && npm run test -w @siro/app
